title: ThinkJev: One Thought, Every Budget for Calibrated Typed Decisions
description_en: arXiv:2610.37732v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many uses of language models end in a typed decision: a choice among a closed set of options, whose probabilities code can act on. Reading those probabilities from one forward pass is fast but often wrong on decisions that take several steps, such as arithmetic, counting, and date comparison. Letting the model think first fixes most of these errors, but costs seconds per decision instead of milliseconds. To pay for thinking only where it helps, ThinkJev builds a fast and a slow system from one open hybrid-thinking model that can answer directly or after a thought. title: Vaani Developer Platform
description_en: The only voice AI harness that you'll ever need. Build a voice agent that sounds and behaves human without writing a single line of code. Design the call flow, handle objections and edge cases, connect your tools and knowledge base, and go live on a real phone number. Every call ends with clean, structured data.

title: SpeakON Agent
description_en: Turn natural speech into real work for an agent to complete. Turn natural speech into real work with SpeakON Agent. It understands your Notes, connects your tools, and prepares Actions for you to review and confirm.

title: Canva Brush
description_en: A vision-language model that edits your designs. Canva Brush is a vision-language model for design from Canva Research. It sees your design, understands how it’s put together, and makes the changes you ask for, from one line of copy to every slide in a deck. Everything stays fully editable. Canva says it’s up to 69% faster and 46% lower cost per edit task than its previous design agent. It’s powering Canva AI design edits for Canva Pro subscribers today.

title: MCP Server by XWiki
description_en: Give your AI your wiki's knowledge while keeping the control. XWiki MCP Server is an open-source, self-hostable extension that connects XWiki to the AI agent of your choice: OpenCode, Pi, Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and more. You can already use the extension to query your knowledge base to get answers, create and edit pages, and work with structured data directly in XWiki. Try out the extension and let us what's should we improve next!

title: SKI
description_en: Voice-first coding harness . Talk to your coding agents and hear them talk back. SKI runs Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Antigravity and pi side by side on your Mac, and tells you the moment one needs you.

title: fastbrowse
description_en: Fastest open source browser agent. A fast open-source browser agent. It reads every button, link and field on the page and has a System One model (ex: jev) pick the next step from that list. If it's unsure, it falls back to a standard model model. Fast, cheap, and every answer provides a citation.

title: Chopstick
description_en: Mac activity and action widgets that write themselves. Chopstick notices what you repeat on your Mac and builds notch widgets for it, using the coding agent you already have. Your activity log stays local.

title: Teable Mobile
description_en: Build the systems your team runs on, now from your phone. Explain your process like you would to a new hire. Teable builds the database, the app and the automations, so the work stops living in your head. Now you can do it from your phone: hold to talk, publish to your team, and get notified when it's done.

title: telemetry.dev
description_en: LLM observability for AI agents. telemetry.dev shows each run of your AI agent as one trace. Each model call and tool call is a span with its duration, tokens, cost, and error. Prompts and evals use the same traces: change a prompt without a deploy, then run it on a dataset and compare the scores with production. Alerts tell you about errors, cost spikes, and agent loops. Connect with our TypeScript or Python SDK, or with the OpenTelemetry exporter that you already use.

title: Faylee
description_en: Bug reports your coding agent can fix from one link. Faylee records the screen, console, every network request and each click behind a bug, on one timeline, and shares it all as one link. Your team opens it and sees exactly what broke, with the failing request already open. Paste the link into Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, and Faylee's MCP server gives the agent the whole report so it can find the cause and fix it. Instant replay saves the last few minutes after a bug already happened. Free for up to 3 members.

title: SparkBots AI (Powered by Jev)
description_en: Instantly extract key details and analyze any webpage or PDF. SparkBots can be trained to deeply analyze any web page or PDF. Once trained, your Sparkbot can be run on similar pages returning answers in less than a second. Perfect for analyzing and extracting key details for leads, businesses, resumes, listings, contracts or any PDF. SparkBot use AI, but it isn't a slow LLM like Claude or ChatGPT. It can't hallucinate or make up details that don't exist. Every answer comes straight from the content on the page and anything it doesn't find is left blank.

title: ilse
description_en: Point at your app and your AI agent changes the code. Ilse puts a toolbar on top of the React app you already have running. Click an element and say what should change, drag to reorder, resize, or tweak spacing and colors with your project's own tokens. Simple tweaks land instantly, with no AI. The rest goes to the agent you already use (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini), pointing at the right spot in the code. Pro adds test mode: Ilse walks real user journeys on her own and reports what breaks.

title: WinnerAdSpy
description_en: Turn competitor ad insights into winning app campaigns. Winneradspy is an ad creative intelligence platform built specifically for mobile app and game marketers. Explore 20M+ ad creatives across 200K+ apps, uncover winning hooks, visuals, messaging and CTAs, and track competitor campaigns with real-time alerts. Unlike generic ad spy tools, it scores creatives as Winner, Loser or Learning, helping UA managers, growth teams and agencies understand what works and build better campaigns. Query ad insights through ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini via MCP.

title: Cluinn
description_en: Answers your questions during the call, not after. For Mac.. Someone asks a question on a call and you need the answer now. Cluinn listens on your Mac and answers mid-call from what was just said, with no bot joining the meeting. Smart Cards flag a question nobody answered. When the call ends you get the action items, and Coach shows how the call went against a goal you set. It also does AI dictation: speak, and clean text lands in any Mac app. For Apple silicon Macs. 14-day trial; LAUNCH30 takes 30% off for 12 months.

title: Backenly
description_en: The autonomous backend for AI coding agents. Backenly is an autonomous backend platform built for coding agents. Your agent builds the backend over MCP, from Postgres to sign-in, storage, functions and realtime. Then it maintains itself: every minute a self-healing loop repairs missing indexes, RLS gaps and dead realtime triggers, verifying each fix live. As your app grows, it restructures its own schema once you approve. Risky changes wait for you, and every change is versioned with rollback.

title: GitHub Copilot Fusion
description_en: GitHub's AI coding agent that picks and combines models. GitHub Copilot Fusion takes the guesswork out of choosing AI models for coding. Instead of picking one model, Fusion automatically routes each task to suitable models and combines them when needed. One model can write code while another reviews or improves it. Choose Standard, High, or Max effort to balance speed, quality, and cost. Available across GitHub Copilot plans in VS Code, Copilot CLI, the Copilot app, and JetBrains IDEs.

title: Axonnic
description_en: Muscle-sensing sleeves for robot training. Axonnic’s forearm sleeve records muscle signals to track finger movement and estimate fingertip force. We combine EMG, video and hand pose into training datasets for robot tasks such as sewing, tool handling and delicate assembly.

title: Kestrix
description_en: Repo-agnostic CI control plane with DAG-based triggers.. Kestrix defines CI/CD pipelines in HCL and resolves them into a DAG. A task runs only when the repositories its trigger names have changed. Live task logs in a React Flow UI, and remote runners that only make outbound HTTPS requests.

title: BaseTab AI
description_en: Turn your new tab into an AI-powered workspace. BaseTab turns your browser's empty new tab into a dashboard you arrange yourself. Drag in 30+ widgets: notes, to-dos, Kanban, Pomodoro, bookmarks, weather, Google Calendar, Gmail, and chat with Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini. Missing a widget? Describe it in plain words and AI builds it for you. Keep separate workspaces for work and life, share one with your team, and pick a background that feels like home. Free forever, works without an account, and asks for site access only when a widget needs it.

title: Coding Wrapped
description_en: See how you really vibe code with Claude Code & Codex. Your agent remembers every session. You don't. Coding Wrapped turns your local Claude Code & Codex history into a pixel-art Wrapped: your rhythm, the words you repeat ("continue", anyone?), what the agent quietly took over, and one small tip for each habit. Open source, one command, 100% local.

title: sitesolide
description_en: Deploy your vibe-coded apps on your own server. You built an app with Claude Code or Cursor and want it online. Run sitesolide deploy in its folder and it goes live on your server, on HTTPS, at its own address. Each app is isolated from the others, and you choose who can open it. Free and open source (MIT): you pay for the server and a domain.

title: Godwit
description_en: An open-source, AI-native email client. Godwit is an open-source desktop email client for any IMAP/SMTP account, with an AI assistant, Wit, that reads, summarizes, translates and drafts mail with the model you choose.

title: Agnos
description_en: Clean documents for AI, and see what was removed. Agnos cleans PDFs, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and web pges before they go into an AI chatbot, a RAG knowlede base or training data. It removes repeated headersand footers, page numbers, cookie banners, boilerplae and duplicates, and keeps tables, code and numbers It names the rule behind every removal; keep a piec or switch its rule off. Exports JSONL chunks, cleand text or training data. Runs on your Windows PC; nohing is uploaded. From the Microsoft Store: 14 days ree, then $99 once.

title: AC Bridge
description_en: Your smart lights show when Claude Code or Codex needs you.. AC Bridge turns the smart lights and plugs you already own into ambient status for Claude Code and Codex. See at a glance whether your agent is working, blocked or done, and let Claude Code or Codex drive the devices you have connected, as a step in a task. Works with Hue, Govee, WLED, LIFX, Nanoleaf and more, plus Home Assistant.

title: Pluto Door
description_en: SSH client with an AI agent and a desktop for every server. This launch adds Ori, an AI agent that reads your servers, finds what's wrong and explains it in plain English. When something needs to change, you see every command first and nothing runs until you approve; every edited file can be undone. Pluto XOS turns each server into a desktop with 15 apps, Hangar installs software in one click, and scheduled checks notify you before small problems grow. Works with AWS, Google Cloud and Azure. Your servers and keys stay on your Mac. Free for 14 days.

title: SpaceO
description_en: Give AI agents their own screen on your Mac. Give AI agents a separate display for real Mac apps while you keep working. Connect through MCP or the CLI, watch sessions in the Viewer, and take over when an agent needs help. Supports native apps and Chromium. Free and MIT licensed; Apple Silicon, macOS 14+. Attention isolation, not a security sandbox: apps run as your macOS user. Runtime support depends on your macOS build.

description_en:
AI video workspace that learns from your team. Make AI video in one place. Blooper remembers your team’s creative decisions, each iteration spends less tokens.
